thread.title: China-Made Scotch Laminators Sold on Amazon Recalled Over Fire Hazard
thread.title_full: China-Made Scotch Laminators Sold on Amazon Recalled Over Fire Hazard

author: NTD
title: China-Made Scotch Laminators Sold on Amazon Recalled Over Fire Hazard
text:
3M is recalling about 53,634 Scotch thermal laminators sold on Amazon because the machines can overheat and catch fire, according to an Oct. 15 notice from the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission.
The company received 63 reports of smoking, melting, and overheating, including five reports of fires and one report of minor property damage. No injuries have been reported.
Identifying the Recalled Machines
The laminators have a light gray or white body with gray accents and the Scotch name printed in gray across the front. Each has a laminating opening approximately 13 inches wide and a carrying handle on the right when viewed from the front.How to Obtain a Refund
Owners must complete an online recall registration form through Scotch’s website, verify that their laminator is covered and upload a photograph showing the machine with its unplugged power cord cut.3M will mail a refund check after receiving the completed form and confirming that the cord has been cut. Consumers should dispose of the machines under state and local electronics recycling requirements.
Other Recent Fire-Related Recalls
The laminator incident follows recalls involving other made-in-China products sold through Amazon, including heated blankets, heating pads, and rechargeable hand warmers.recalledlast month after the company received 577 reports of products smoking, melting or catching fire. Fifty-three burn injuries were reported.
The commission announced that recall Sept. 17 because internal heating wires could overheat. The Chinese-made products were sold on Amazon from September 2022 through July 2026. Consumers were instructed to stop using them and contact JKMAX for refunds.
recalledabout 77,000 HotHands rechargeable hand warmers because their lithium-ion batteries and electrical parts could overheat and ignite.
Those warmers were sold from July 2025 through August 2026 at retailers nationwide and online through Amazon for approximately $30 to $40. No incidents or injuries had been reported.
The HotHands recall, announced Oct. 1, covers white-and-orange rechargeable devices bearing model number H163650 and a white logo. Consumers should stop using them and seek refunds. Unlike the laminators, the battery-powered warmers require disposal under applicable hazardous-waste rules and must not enter household trash or ordinary recycling streams.
summary: 3M is recalling about 53,634 Scotch thermal laminators sold on Amazon because the machines can overheat and catch fire, according to an Oct. 15 notice from the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission.
